title: Artis, knobbelganzen - SoundCloud - Beeld en Geluid
author: Beeld en Geluid
changes: Domestic swan goose (Chinese goose) recorded at Artis zoo, Amsterdam. Trimmed to 50.45–52.60 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 70 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
